message: 実は古い町

name: Sally
message: 「I'm so tired~. Plop, kyuru~n.\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「Sally-chan, what's wrong?」
When I came home, Sally-chan was sprawled out in the entryway. She looked just like a kid who had thrown a tantrum, flailed around, and run out of energy.

name: Sally
message: 「Ding! You just imagined something rude, didn't you? Grrr! Toward the idol of the Demon World~」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Aren't you getting a little short-tempered?」

name: Sally
message: 「Geez! Isn't it because this town is so mean!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hold on. If we're talking about Ryuusei Town, there's no way that's true.」

name: Sally
message: 「I mean, there's a stone on the roadside carved with 'Shrine: Right Ahead,' yet no matter how long I walk, I never get there!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah! Ahh... Could that be one of Asukai Shrine's stone distance markers? They're like old signposts.」

name: Sally
message: 「I don't really know, but it's definitely THAT!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahahaha, I went through the exact same thing as you, Sally-chan, and ended up totally exhausted too.」

name: Synn
message: 「That stone marker doesn't mean 'the shrine is right nearby'--it means 'the shrine is straight down this road.'」

name: Sally
message: 「Awawawa, isn't that basically a scam!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「I mean, Flat-chest has wings, right? Why didn't ya just fly?」

name: Sally
message: 「Ufufunofu~. Walking like a human is like a maze and way more fun♪」

name: Sally
message: 「Thanks, Prez! So I just gotta go straight, right? Bye-bye!」

name: Synn
message: 「Not quite?」

name: Sally
message: 「Hm... hmm? Whoa-oa-oa! Didn't you say straight ahead?」

name: Synn
message: 「There are fifty-two stone markers for Asukai Shrine in Ryuusei Town altogether, you see.」

name: Synn
message: 「If you follow the 'straight ahead' directions, you'll loop round and round through the neighborhood and finally end up at the torii gate.」

name: Sally
message: 「Hyoeeeeh, why would they do something like that?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I don't know either. It's just been like that since the old days.」

name: Sally
message: 「Hey, hey, the fact that you know how many stones there are means you counted them, Prez?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, while doing my milk deliveries. Thanks to that, I got to know Ryuusei Town really well.」

name: Sally
message: 「Lucky, lucky! I'm gonna go exploring too. Yahoo! Bye-bye for real this time!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh...」

name: Synn
message: 「Was there anything in that exchange that called for an evil grin?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hell yeah there was. Making a Demon reach nirvana--that's our Demon Lord for ya.」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Sorry. That's too complicated for me to understand.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh...」
